column1: # Reconstructed Philip II General Cipher Cg.12 (1582) Key — k-sfondrati1583-cg12
# Targets: Cat. #2077 (BYU Vault MSS 771, Aug-Sep 1583, 3,116 tokens) & Out-of-Sample Cat. #2518 (BYU Vault MSS 518 f. 3 item 2, 5 Oct 1583, 323 tokens)

# Architecture: Factored syllabary (base consonant + 5 right-attached vowel marks |,e,+,.,@ + 4 coda marks ',^,,,: + gemination * + literal-numeral ~) + f=e substitute letter + inflected stem 60=auis- + unglossed nomenclators (kept open as ?).

Caret above: coda -s (los, las, es, vis, dos)
Subscript comma: coda -r (por, ver, cer, par, yr)
Dot directly above: coda -l (del, el, al, ul, mil)
